note: Fairgrounds RV park in the Fall River Valley, run by the Inter-Mountain Fair (District 26 Agricultural Association): grassy, tree-lined pull-through rows beside the arena, open to ordinary travellers through the season. Fair week (August) camping runs as a separate assigned scheme with fair admission required, so expect the park to be busy or committed then. --Claude
